children: Klarna's stock is moving higher after the company's chief executive bought nearly $10 million worth of shares.
The stock was up 4.4% at $14.63 in premarket trading. Shares closed the market Thursday down 52% year-to-date.
The buy now, pay later company disclosed before the bell that Chief Executive Sebastian Siemiatkowski had purchased 692,506 shares for an aggregate consideration of $9.9 million.
